title: DarGlobal | International Luxury Real Estate Developer (homepage snapshot)
text:
DarGlobal is a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations and lifestyle-driven assets across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, Oman and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment and exclusive golf communities.
Key figures (indicative, aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026): 32 years track record; $23B gross development value; 7 international markets; 12+ global brand partners.
Featured projects: AIDA (Oman, masterplan, one of the world's largest premium mixed-use developments); Trump International Simaisma, Qatar; Trump Mansions at Wadi Safar, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Brand partners: Aston Martin, Elie Saab, FENDI Casa, Automobili Lamborghini, Marriott (Marriott Residences AIDA Oman), Missoni, Mouawad, Pagani, The Trump Organization, W Residences by Marriott International, Paramount.
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), deploying capital in equity, debt and hybrid instruments across GCC, European and US gateway markets.
DarGlobal is also pursuing real estate tokenization and digital ownership structures, private membership clubs (including a members club in Jeddah) and golf-anchored communities.
Recent news: Nov 16, 2026 - new SAR 1 billion mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Oct 26, 2026 - DGCP targets high-value Dubai real estate opportunities. Oct 07, 2026 - sales opened for Trump Villas at Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar. Sep 30, 2026 - 66% revenue growth in HY 2026, portfolio GDV reaches $23bn. Aug 06, 2026 - Gulf Asia Contracting appointed for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Jun 29, 2026 - Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman announced with FENDI Casa interiors, within AIDA.
